text: Oh no, wild Qubits have found us! Let's understand our enemy before we defend ourselves.
See that strange | ⟩ notation? That just holds the state of the qubit. If a dangerous |0⟩ slips past our defenses, we lose HP!
Our goal is to flip them into harmless |1⟩ states so we don't take damage.
Grab the X flipper from the top bar! It magically flips a |0⟩ into a |1⟩ as the enemy passes through.
Click a grid line to place your X flipper. Right-click if you want to remove it. Press ▶ when you're ready!
Perfect! A gate acts on every qubit that passes through it, so one well-placed gate can handle a whole lane.
You survived! But what was that HP system about? When a qubit hits the left edge, we 'measure' it. Measurement forces it to collapse into either |0⟩ or |1⟩.
The top number α tells us how likely it is to collapse to |0⟩ — specifically, it's |α|² (alpha squared). A pure |0⟩ means α=1, so P(0)=100% and we take 100 damage!
This |α|² rule is called Born's Rule, one of the foundations of quantum mechanics. Our HP loss is just the expected damage from that random collapse.
Those flippers you used? In quantum mechanics, they are actually called 'gates'.
Place an X gate in lane 1 and watch the numbers! X swaps the top and bottom: 1|0⟩+0|1⟩ becomes 0|0⟩+1|1⟩. The top goes to 0 so no damage!
Now try a Y gate in lane 2. Y also swaps the amplitudes, but multiplies them by -i and i. The output looks different, but the top is still 0... so damage is still 0!
Try the Z gate in lane 3. Z multiplies only the bottom amplitude by -1. Watch the numbers change... but notice the top amplitude stays the same. Damage is unchanged!
So X and Y both block damage, while Z seems useless for now. But Z did change the numbers! That -1 will matter a lot in the next level. For now, use X and Y to survive!
You survived! X and Y blocked the |0⟩ enemies completely. Z changed the numbers but not the damage. Remember that -1 twist — it won't always be useless.
Remember that -1 twist from Z that didn't help last time? This level is why it exists.
Your new enemies are in state 1/√2|0⟩ + 1/√2|1⟩. The top and bottom are equal, so there's a 50% chance of |0⟩. You'll take 50 damage if nothing happens.
You have an H gate! H is special — it mixes the top and bottom amplitudes together. Try placing just an H and see what happens...
Surprise! H turns 1/√2|0⟩+1/√2|1⟩ into a pure |0⟩. That's 100 damage — even worse than doing nothing! Why?
Because when you add 1/√2 + 1/√2, they reinforce each other into 1. H amplified the |0⟩. We need to break that reinforcement.
Now add a Z gate to the right of your H gate (so qubits hit Z first). Z flips the bottom to -1/√2. Now H sees +1/√2 and -1/√2 — they cancel out! The |0⟩ vanishes. Zero damage!
You used quantum interference! When two amplitudes with opposite signs meet, they cancel. Z set up the cancellation, and H triggered it. This is the secret inside every quantum computer.
